actionItems: Investigate the cause of flaky behaviour in 'Login and Logout @shard2' and 'SIMS_TB_SCHOOL - XQuery Report - Execute @shard2'.
Analyze the impact of the recent code changes on financial report tests.
Review the test environment configurations for potential discrepancies.
Monitor the stability of tests during peak usage times for further insights.
Conduct a deeper analysis of the error messages related to the 'NML510 - Trial Balance Report'.
executiveSummary: Two tests, 'Login and Logout @shard2' and 'SIMS_TB_SCHOOL - XQuery Report - Execute @shard2', showed new flaky behaviour after the pivot date.
Flaky rates increased from 0% to 17%, which may indicate timing issues introduced by recent changes.
The 'NML510 - Trial Balance Report' improved from 40% to 33% failure rate, suggesting some positive adjustments were made.
The observed flaky behaviour could reflect instability in the test environment or dependencies.
These issues may affect user confidence in the reliability of login processes and report generation.
